description: Health Care Professions explores the many careers in medicine and health care — physicians and specialists, nursing, pharmacy and emergency medicine, therapy and nutrition, lab and imaging — plus a workplace visit, medical ethics and privacy, new advances, and volunteering.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Health Care Professions replaced the Medicine merit badge in 2021.
